Scene and Character: A young Indian woman wearing a beautiful white embroidered salwar kameez, matching white trousers, and a lightweight white dupatta. Her long, dark hair is tied back. No cuts, no camera shakes, no sudden zooms, and no scene transitions. Soft natural daylight, realistic shadows, natural skin texture, detailed white fabric embroidery, realistic hair movement, and authentic rural Indian surroundings.

prompts.text:
Use the provided Instagram profile screenshot as the exact starting frame. The real character shown in the profile picture comes alive inside the circular DP, climbs out of the profile photo, and physically steps onto the Instagram screen, becoming a tiny, photorealistic miniature version of himself.

ACTION SEQUENCE — FOLLOW THIS ORDER EXACTLY:

Step 1: Climb out of the DP. The character visibly emerges from INSIDE the circular profile picture, crosses the circular boundary, and carefully steps onto the Instagram interface. Keep his face, hairstyle, outfit, body build, and identity consistent with the original character.

Step 2: Clean the follower count FIRST. The miniature character walks toward the follower count beside the profile picture. He takes a small cleaning cloth out of his pocket, unfolds it naturally, and carefully wipes away the existing follower NUMBER only. Make sure he cleans the actual number above the word “followers,” NOT the bio. The number disappears completely, leaving a clean blank space. Keep the word “followers” unchanged.

Step 3: Clean the bio SECOND. After finishing the follower count, he moves down to the bio text below the profile statistics. Using the same cloth, he carefully wipes away the bio text until it disappears. Do not clean any other text or profile elements.

Step 4: Final pose. After cleaning both areas, he lowers the cloth, steps beside the profile information, and stands confidently facing the camera. He does not write anything or replace any text.

All movement comes from the miniature character. His walking, reaching, unfolding the cloth, wiping, and final pose must be smooth, natural, and physically believable.

REALISM AND CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: Photorealistic miniature human, natural anatomy, realistic body weight and proportions, accurate facial identity, natural hand movements, believable cloth-to-screen contact, realistic shadows, consistent lighting, and correct perspective. Keep the character's original body build; do not make him look skinny, stretched, or distorted.

STRICT RULES:
Clean the follower number FIRST.
Clean the bio SECOND.
Use the cloth to wipe both areas.
Do not use a marker.
Do not write a new number or replacement text.
Do not accidentally wipe the word “followers” or any other profile elements.
Preserve the username, profile picture, buttons, highlights, and post thumbnails.
No cuts, no transitions, no motion graphics, no artificial overlays, no duplicated character, no flickering, and no body morphing.

The final result should look like a real miniature version of the original person climbing out of his own Instagram DP and physically cleaning the follower count first and the bio second in one smooth, uninterrupted shot.

prompts.title: Prompt 4 · Video
prompts.text:
Use the final frame of the first video as the exact starting frame. Continue seamlessly with the same miniature man standing beside his Instagram profile.

SCENE 2 — AYUDHA POOJA DECORATION AND AARTI

STEP 1 — DECORATE THE PROFILE: The miniature man picks up fresh orange and yellow marigold garlands mixed with white jasmine flowers. He carefully hangs the garlands across the TOP and SIDES of the large Instagram profile in the background. He uses both hands to arrange the flowers neatly around the profile frame, making it look like a beautifully decorated Ayudha Pooja shrine. He does NOT put any garland around his own neck.

STEP 2 — DECORATE THE FLOOR: He walks to the bottom of the Instagram profile and decorates the floor with colorful flower garlands and loose flower petals. He carefully arranges the flowers around the base of the profile and places traditional glowing brass oil lamps on both sides. All decorations are placed through realistic physical movements.

STEP 3 — PICK UP THE WHITE PUMPKIN: After finishing the decorations, he picks up a white pumpkin with both hands. A tiny piece of burning camphor rests on top, producing a natural golden flame and delicate smoke. He holds the pumpkin securely at chest height and faces the decorated Instagram profile.

STEP 4 — PERFORM AARTI: He respectfully performs aarti in front of the fully decorated Instagram profile, moving the pumpkin in gentle, controlled circular motions. The camphor flame flickers naturally, and thin smoke rises softly. His expression is calm and devotional.

CAMERA: Continue from the previous video's exact ending position. Use one continuous, smooth cinematic take with gentle, stabilized camera movement. Keep the man and the Instagram profile visible. No sudden zooms, shaking, abrupt reframing, or cuts.

REALISM: Maintain the original face, hairstyle, brown shirt, beige cargo pants, white sneakers, and natural body build. Realistic hands, natural walking, believable flower placement, accurate shadows, realistic fire and smoke, and consistent lighting.

STRICT RULES: The man decorates ONLY the Instagram profile and the floor with flower garlands. He NEVER wears a garland himself. He does not put flowers around his neck. The white pumpkin is used only for performing aarti in front of the decorated profile. Do not change the Instagram interface or character identity. No teleportation, no sudden appearance of objects, no duplicated limbs, no artificial overlays, and no motion graphics.

FINAL FRAME: The Instagram profile is richly decorated with flower garlands, the floor is covered with colorful flowers, brass lamps glow warmly, and the man performs aarti with the white pumpkin and burning camphor in front of the completed Ayudha Pooja setup.
